text: Procurators () are a type of navigation A.I. in the universe of the Xenosaga series, most often used to retrieve data and services in the U.M.N.. Shion Uzuki made her own compact Procurator modeled after Bunnie that she has on her Connection Gear.

Proto Gardis is an enemy in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. This enemy is fought in the training exercise at the virtual version of the Galaxy Federation Police Station. It does not attack, but it does call in Gardis F1 reinforcements.
Protocancer is an enemy in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. This enemy is fought in the outdoor city areas in Mikhail's trap.
Rankar Dragon a boss in Xenogears. It is encountered in the Blackmoon Forest.

Rage Strike is a mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles 2s Bringer of Chaos difficulty. The first art an enemy uses after enraging applies this debuff on top of everything else, which deals an extra +200% damage and depletes 50 points (half a bar) from the per hit. This can be repeated if the enemy can enrage multiple times. The gauge reduction can be prevented with the accessories Ocean Earring (60-70%) and Seven-Seas Earring (90-100%).

Ranged Attack is a stat for both ground and Skell units in Xenoblade Chronicles X that represents a combatant's ranged attack power. This directly improves the damage done by ranged weapons' s and non-TP s. Ranged Attack can be buffed temporarily using the buff named . Also, the Ranged Attack Probe grants a permanent buff to the ranged attack stat.

Queen Kiss is the second multiplayer level in Xeno-pittan's simultaneous mode. This is named after 's Queen's Kiss ether ability. The level is built in the shape of a heart. The text (Shion Queen Kiss) is written along the heart.
Request from Teach is a discussion in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It is acquired by completing Teach's hero quest Going Beyond Power. Completing it automatically starts the quest Teach's Teachers.

Enemies calling for reinforcements is a gameplay mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. Enemies have two main ways to call for reinforcements, ing nearby, already existing, enemies into the battle or summoning new enemies. It is possible to seal enemies' ability to call for reinforcement with a dark Blade Combo finisher.

It plays in the following scenes: * The Red Testament and Wilhelm discuss KOS-MOS in Episode 3. * The Elsa rescues Ziggy and MOMO in Episode 4. * KOS-MOS awakens with the detection of the Zohar Emulator in Episode 4. * Lapis Roman places the Durandal under Galaxy Federation custody in Episode 7. * Togashi sends the PT cannon to the party in Episode 10.
The SOL-9000 is a large computer in Xenogears. It contains the digitized versions of the remaining eight members of the Gazel Ministry after their bodies were destroyed during the Solaris War.

Scientia is an anti-U.M.N. resistance organization in the Xenosaga series. They specialize in operations of guerilla warfare tactics against the U.M.N. administration and its affiliates, including the Galaxy Federation and Vector Industries.
Second Miltia City is an area in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse. This article refers to the area while the party is being pursued by the U-TIC Organization.
The Sargasso is an area in Xenogears. The party members head there to destroy the third Gate hiding Solaris.

Senir is a planet in the Xenosaga series. It is home to a secret U-TIC Organization testing facility.

The Seraphim Sisters are a pop idol duo in the Xenosaga series. Captain Matthews is a big fan of theirs. The names of the two singers in the duo are Julia and Chloe. Their home planet is Keltia.
Shevat Palace is a sub-area of in Xenogears. It is the seat of power of the nation of Shevat.

Skell Arts are the abilities that form characters' movesets in Xenoblade Chronicles X while they are in Skells. They are available via a horizontal selection at the bottom of the screen when an enemy is being targeted or a weapon is drawn. These Arts are primarily used in combat; many are attacks (generally stronger than ), while others help the player in other ways such as healing or providing temporary buffs. Up to 8 Skell Arts may be available in combat at once. Unlike with s, the Art depends upon the Skell weapon equipped. When the player presses R when viewing their Skell Gear inventory, they can see the Art's effects, although the name of the Art itself is only visible in combat. The t

Skell weapons are pieces of equipment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They determine the type and strength of attacks a Skell may use in combat. Sidearms affect the Skell's types while the Art weapons: the back, shoulder, arm, and spare weapons, determine the Skell's Skell Arts. Skells can generally equip a maximum of ten Skell weapons (two of each type), although some weapons take up more slots if they are too large for just one side.

Soaring - Wings is a piece performed at the Xenogears 20th Anniversary Concert -The Beginning and the End-, and the 18th track on the associated Blu-Ray disc. The first half is a performance of Flight, and the second half (from 2:11) is a performance of Wings.

The Solaris War, also known as the Great War was a devastating war in Xenogears that broke out between the Sacred Empire of Solaris and the surface-dwellers, mainly composed of Shevat, Nisan, Nimrod and other smaller nations. The war lasted for five years which culminates in the Day of Collapse. Its aftermath and legacy plays a profound role in several people's lives up to the present day.

The Spears of Samaar are fetters in the shape of spears in Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition. They are shackles to restrain Void's power while he was imprisoned in Volitaris.

The Species Preservation Act, is a law in the Xenosaga series. It was enacted by the Galaxy Federation in the wake of the controversies of the Life Recycling Act.

The Subcommittee on Close Encounters, often shortened to the S.O.C.E. or the Contact Subcommittee, is a clerical branch of the Galaxy Federation government in the Xenosaga series. Their primary goal is combating the Gnosis phenomenon. Seven members sit at its central core, but the organization consists of over 2000 officials representing government agencies, corporations, and various scientific fields.
The Submerged City () is an area in Xenosaga I & II. It is visited at the start of .
The Awakened (Power) is one of 's Battle Skills in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.
The Colony 15 Folk is a discussion in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It can be obtained after reaching and Life in the City. Completing it automatically starts the quest Colony 15 Soldiers Missing.

Tension with the City is a discussion in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It can be acquired after having completed , , and The True Inspector. Discussing it automatically initiates the quest The Path I Forge.
Tech Attacks are very powerful attacks in Xenosaga Episode I.

The Theocratic Government of Miltia was the acting regime of the Miltian star system shortly before and during the Miltian Conflict in the Xenosaga series. It was the government system that succeeded the Miltian Republic and preceded the Second Miltian Autonomous State.
Transmit Power is one of 's Driver Skills in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.

Titan weapons are a type of Titans in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country which have been modified to be used as weapons. These weapons are used by their respective nations on the battlefield during times of war, boasting great firepower.
The Torres Foundation is a foundation in the Xenosaga series. They are affiliated with both the Galaxy Federation and the Immigrant Fleet.

U.R.T.V.s (spelled URTV in Episode III), short for U-DO Retro Virus, are a type of genetically modified human in the Xenosaga series. Dmitri Yuriev is the genetic father of all 669 U.R.T.V.s. Their sole purpose is to destroy U-DO.

The U.M.N. (short for Unus Mundus Network) is an informational network that spans the entirety of the Xenosaga universe. Its existence has brought about technology such as faster than light speed communication and transportation.

The trion barrier is a translucent wall in Xenoblade Chronicles X used to protect the Lifehold Core. It is part of Trion technology which, according to Luxaar, only the Qlu system should have access to. The barrier is one of the technologies that Elma brought to Earth. Normally the barrier is fully translucent but when it's attacked a grid of light blue hexagons can be briefly seen. The trion barrier can withstand most attacks. During , the Ganglion were not able to damage it in any way until Luxaar decided to deploy with the Vita and was finally able to pierce a hole in the barrier.

U.M.N. Terrorist B is an enemy in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. This is the stat block for the enemy when fought in random encounters in the training exercise set in the virtual Galaxy Federation Police Station.

Underhander is a Skell Art in Xenoblade Chronicles X, attached to the G-Revolver series of shoulder-mounted Skell weapons. This is a version of the Underhander that was taken from Galdrs like the Armed Destroyer Galdr or Vendura's Galdr.

Velocity Gear is one of 's Battle Skills in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.
Unyielding Heart is the fourth skill in 's Reliability skill branch. It halves the accuracy penalty from being in low , changing it from -50% to -25%.
Vector Industries is a company in the Xenosaga series. It is the largest intergalactic conglomerate in the Galaxy Federation and was founded by Wilhelm.
Unlock Kits are a special type of in Future Redeemed. They are used to enhance each party member's combat abilities.

The Vaporizer is a plug-in for the Connection Gear in Xenosaga Episode I - Der Wille zur Macht that is used to destroy objects on the field. Initially, the player only has this tool in the KOS-MOS Simulator. However, one of the mechanics in the Woglinde hangar will give one to Shion when the ship is under attack by Gnosis. Once Shion acquires this item, all party members are able to use the Vaporizer.
Vote of Confidence is the first skill in 's Affection skill branch. It adds 25% to the power of healing Arts she uses when warned of a vision.
The Vessel of Anima is a form of power that exists in the Xenosaga series.

Worn Destroyer Dual Guns II are a in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Worldbutcher is a used by (including in the Old City) in Future Redeemed.

Xeno-pittans dictionary is based on the corpus of the original Moji-pittan dictionary, but expands (and sometimes replaces) it with vocabulary from the Xenosaga universe. When a word is put down, a "corrected" spelling and a short dictionary definition is displayed for a short time. If a kana spelling could refer to multiple words, the game alternated between the different possible definitions.

The Xenosaga series is a subseries of the Xeno series, following Xenogears and preceding the series. It was primarily developed by Monolith Soft and published by Namco. The games are set in a science fiction universe approximately 4000 years after 20xx A.D., with many important story events taking place in the years T.C. 4767 and 4768.
The unnamed planet is the world where Xenogears takes place. It is also referred to as "Earth" by its inhabitants.

The Y-Data is an extensive log of Joachim Mizrahi's research data and the target of several factions in the Xenosaga universe. The only remaining copy is hidden within the neural network of MOMO Mizrahi.

Ziggurat 8, nicknamed Ziggy (), originally known as Jan Sauer (), is a playable character in the Xenosaga series and the main protagonist of Xenosaga: Pied Piper. He is a combat cyborg resurrected by Ziggurat Industries who was assigned to protect MOMO. In life, Jan Sauer was a Federation police officer on the planet Abraxas.

The Zohar Emulators are replica s in the Xenosaga series. Twelve of them were made by Joachim Mizrahi. In appearance, they are almost identical to the Original except where its glowing turquoise gem would be, a Hebrew letter sits. Another, albeit notably more unstable, Emulator was created by Sellers. Sellers' Emulator is metallic silver and has a flashing blue logo representing the Galaxy Federation's military in place of the jewel.
Zavarov is a planet in the Xenosaga series. It is the location of the Yuriev Institute. As such, it is heavily featured in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse.
The Zohar Project is an anti-Gnosis project implemented by the Galaxy Federation in the Xenosaga series.
Cabaret Club Czar (, Mizushōbai Airando, lit. "Nightlife Island") is a Yakuza 0 minigame in which Goro Majima runs Club Sunshine.
A Fading Star is the 25th substory featured in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.
The Basan Prototype (, Jikken-tai Basan, lit. Experimental Body Basan) is a mutant in Yakuza: Dead Souls. It is a dragon-bat hybrid creature that is able to fly.
Abilities and Upgrades is a system of experience featured throughout the Yakuza series. Throughout each entry it has come in many different mechanics.
Action Star is a job featured in Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth. It is a male-exclusive job.
A Powerful Foe Appears: Kamurocho is one of the trouble missions in Yakuza 6.
Club Moon is a cabaret club located in Sotenbori. It is managed by Tsukiyama.
Early Honeymoon (, Konzen ryokō, Lit. "Premarital Trip") is an Okinawa substory in Yakuza 3. It was cut from the original western version of the game, but is included in the remaster.
Fast Times at Ounabara (, Ōunabara e Tobikome!, Lit. "Dive into Ounabara/the ocean!") is the tenth substory in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.
City Slicker is one of the Sujimon that can be found in the game Yakuza: Like a Dragon.

Family Photo is a Party chat found in Yakuza: Like a Dragon. The conversation is triggered outside an unnamed photo studio near Love Magic in the Red Light District of Isezaki Ijincho. Adachi and Saeko must have been recruited for the conversation to trigger.

Freelancer (, Furītā), also known as Yakuza (, Arakawa-gumi Kumi-in, lit. "Member of the Arakawa Family"), Arakawa Loyalist (, Moto Arakawa-gumi Kumi-in, lit. "Ex-Member of the Arakawa Family"), Deadbeat (, Minarai Hōmuresu, lit. "Apprentice Homeless Guy") and Hello Worker, is a job class featured in Yakuza: Like a Dragon and Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth. It is one of Ichiban Kasuga's exclusive Jobs that he inherits at the beginning of the games, before swapping to Hero during the games' story's progression. Afterwards, the player can only switch back to Freelancer once the ability to swap Jobs is available (via Hello Work in Yakuza: Like a Dragon or Alo-Happy Tours in Infinite Wealth).
Flight of the Game Creator (, Tōbōshita Gēmu Kurieitā, Lit. "The Escaped Game Creator") is the 19th side case in Lost Judgment.
Dastardly Detective: The Final Night Flight (, Denpa Tantei: Saigo no Yonige, Lit. "Radio Wave Detective: The Final Night Escape") is the 29th side case in Lost Judgment.

The Val'sharah druids are led by Lea Stonepaw and consider Ursoc their patron. Drisburg was a town on the northern coast of Kul Tiras. Many of its citizens were gnome and dwarf immigrants from Khaz Modan.

Drohn's Distillery Barker stands beside Drohn's Distillery Stand advertising their particular brews at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar. If you pick up a Alcohol-Free Brewfest Sampler and throw it, the Barkers will toss you another refill.

Drunken Brewfest Revelers are goblins and dwarves found drinking and partying at the Brewfest festivals and fairgrounds outside the capital cities during the Brewfest holiday. The more sober party guests are the Brewfest Revelers. The drunks are all completely hammered. The dwarven revelers are reeking, shirtless drunkards.

The Drowned Reaches is a great ship graveyard located on the southeastern edge of the Boiling Terrace. Since 10,000 years ago, ships that run afoul of the Maelstrom are caught in its whirlpool, sucked downward, and the currents rip them asunder and deposit their remains here. Both the Horde and the Alliance lost numerous ships to the Drowned Reaches during the exodus to Kalimdor. Because the sailors die in fear and agony and are surrounded by the Maelstrom's unstable influence, the dead often do not find peace. Murlocs and makrura live side by side in the area, thriving in the wet, gloomy environment. Like most of Blackfathom, the cavern ceiling is littered with thick tree roots, where dark wisps provide an eerie illumination. The Drowned Sacellum is the first room players reach after the instance portal of Blackfathom Deeps. Druids for the Ethical and Humane Treatment of Animals (D.E.H.T.A.) is an organization based primarily in Northrend and is a radical portion of the Cenarion Expedition. The organization was created in direct opposition to master hunter Hemet Nesingwary. They are opposed to what is essentially the decimation of the wildlife caused by Nesingwary and his hunters, and they also give players the chance to battle Hemet's hunters. If you kill any animal in the Borean Tundra, including hostile ones, you will be given the debuff Animal Blood. A Druid of the Nightmare is a variant class of druid. Not all druids revere the Emerald Dream. A few rare and twisted individuals channel the Nightmare, a rent in the perfection of the Emerald Dream. Most of these druids of the Nightmare were once normal druids who inadvertently came in contact with the Nightmare (often while dreamwalking) and fell under its insidious influence. However, an increasing number of people have become druids of the Nightmare through their own volition. Whereas traditional druids seek a communion with nature, druids of the Nightmare become increasingly divorced from the natural order. The Drunken Northsea Pirate is a drunk human pirate located at the Scalawag Point in Howling Fjord.

Drolfy is a gnome stationed at the Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. After the Bloodpaw tribe forced Drolfy and his cousins, Skrotee and Brote (whom he believes may have been captured or killed by the Bloodpaw) to flee from the Eldritch Heights, Drolfy put a bounty on the High Shaman Bloodpaw.

Drohn's Distillery Festive Keg can be found in Durotar during the Brewfest holiday. Using your or will fill them up, when you spend at least 10 seconds drinking it, you will gain a +2 Stamina and spirit Well Fed buff.

Drohn's Distillery Festive Wagon can be found in outside the Horde major cities (except for Orgrimmar) during the Brewfest holiday. Using your or will fill them up, when you spend at least 10 seconds drinking it, you will gain a +2 Stamina and spirit Well Fed buff.
Drool is a Forsaken rogue who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).

Drix Blackwrench is one of two Horde vendors that come preloaded with a three person mammoth mount, the Reins of the Traveler's Tundra Mammoth#Horde. He can repair as well as sell reagents and poisons. Users can interact with him so long as he is still mounted on the mammoth. You do not need to be in a group with the player to interact with the mount NPC's.

Druids of the Antler are night elf druids found at Malorne's Refuge in Val'sharah. Some are sitting on benches or lying wounded on the ground, while others are helping Broll Bearmantle protect the refuge from the nearby Darkfiend Raiders. They are present during Legion Assaults on Val'sharah.

Drostan is a level 76 dwarf quest giver located at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin. He instructs adventurers to shoot an apple off of Lucky Wilhelm's head. He also has a competition with adventurers to see who can kill 60 animals in the Basin first. The adventurers win the competition by killing 60 animals compared to his 58.

Drive Me Crazy (10 player) was a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Yogg-Saron without any raid member going insane on 10-player mode. An good way to make this is with the help of watcher Freya.
In order to be eligible for this quest, players are required to have been awarded the title .
Drop It Now! is a legacy achievement, originally earned for killing 5 players carrying seaforium in a single battle of Strand of the Ancients battleground.
Drop It! is a legacy achievement, originally earned for killing 100 players carrying seaforium in the Strand of the Ancients battleground.
Drums of Forgotten Kings is crafted with Leatherworking (450); taught by trainers.
The Druidic Channeler's Mace is a quest reward from The Return of Baron Geddon.
The Drums of the Turtle God are provided as an objective for Magma Monarch.

Drudgetown is a slum that makes up the southern section of Bilgewater Port. It consists of several shacks built under the roads and waste pipes that go over it. Debtors and deadbeats hide here. One side of The Pipe exits here. A much more built section of this slum is known as Copper Street.

Drill Sergeant Magnus is dwarf located at The Headland in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He is one of the three instructors training dwarves in combat. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the area with a new sword.
Drunken Style Bracers are a quest reward from Deeper into Darkness.
Dronk Drophammer is a blacksmithing vendor located in the neutral town of Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows. He can be found outside by the anvil.
Drukma is an orc pet trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Players must use Drowned Thunder Lizard Tail near Golden Stonefish in order to kill it.

__NOTOC__ Drowned Thunder Lizards were thunder lizards that lived in Thunder Ridge before the Cataclysm. Their home became flooded and most of them couldn't manage to escape the deadly waters. Despite their death, corpses of these lizards are still able to occasionally discharge the lightning around their bodies.
Drillmaster Razgoth has a chance to spawn at Baradin Hold in Tol Barad. He will only offer dailies after the Horde have won the previous game in Tol Barad.
Drown Your Sorrows is an exploration achievement earned for drinking the beverages added in Cataclysm.

Drowning Watchmen litter the waters that have overtaken the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas after the Cataclysm. They are all that remains of the fighters that attempted to stave off the Forsaken invasion.

Driz Plunkbow is a goblin quest giver found in Gadgetzan, Tanaris. He is interested in profiting off of the local beasts, with the use of his own invention: the butcherbot. During the Legion Invasions, he was one of the defenders of Gadgetzan, using several butcherbots to combat the demons.

__NOTOC__ The Druids of the Flame are a group of druids in the Sulfuron Keep Courtyard of the Firelands. Some are in cat form while one continuously casting Kneel to the Flame. All of them must be killed before you can face Majordomo Staghelm.
The Drum of the Soothed Earth is provided as an objective for The Restless Earth. Use at the Bael'dun Digsite.
The Drunken Hozen is the tavern and inn of Dawn's Blossom, under the proprietorship of Peiji Goldendraft.
Drudge Ghouls are summoned by the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel.

Drothvader is a mostly harmless pink-haired gnome that happens to be a Diablo III community MVP. He is also presumed to be alive and kicking, though reports of this cannot be confirmed. A lord of the Sith sometimes gets busy, you know?
